thread:
Priya: Heads-up — canary for 2.3.1 with updated quant pipeline is showing a regression on INT8 generation long-seq. perf-ci alarmed: p95 up ~25% vs baseline.

perf-ci: [automated] smoke/perf/gen_long_sequence_int8 failed on canary. baseline gen_p95=180ms, canary gen_p95=225ms (+25%).

Marco: I repro'd locally. Extra ~40ms per call. nvprof points at a dequant-copy kernel that wasn't hot before. Suspect kernel selection changes from the recent quant-fusion merge.

Sam: Which merge/PR? Can we bisect quickly?

Marco: git bisect -> first-bad points to commit 2e9c5a (PR #3421: "quant-fusion: kernel selector tweaks"). That change added an alignment-and-format check that falls back to dequant-copy for some INT8 layouts.

Jenna: Note PR #3421 also touched KV cache packing/layout. If the runtime repacks cached KV blobs we could be paying extra per-layer copies + dequant. That would balloon on long sequences.

Priya: Repro steps I used: 
```
./tools/perf/run_local.sh --profile int8 --model redwood-7b --seq 1024 --batch 1
# collect nvprof and perf map
```

Marco: nvprof breakdown (summary):
```
dequant_copy_kernel        3.8ms  (hot)
fused_attn_int8_kernel     0.2ms
kv_pack_serialization     1.1ms
other kernels             10-20ms
```
So fused path seems skipped and we're doing a copy+dequant per layer.

Alex: The selector added extra checks even on small seqs, but perf only shows on long seqs due to accumulation. Also packing layout mismatch will force repack on cache hit.

perf-ci: @eng-runtime FYI, this is blocking CI perf gates. Job: https://ci.internal/perf/1761956

Priya: Pausing the canary. Decision: revert #3421 to restore perf baseline or hotfix selector to preferentially pick fused kernels for long seqs.

Jenna: Revert is fastest. I've prepared PR #3425 (revert of #3421).

Sam: Initiating rollback. ops-bot: pause canary deployment 2.3.1 -> status: in-progress :hourglass:

ops-bot: Canary paused by @Sam. Alerts sent to infra and oncall.

Marco: Alternative quick fix: make selector prefer fused path when model.config.quant_profile == "production_int8_v2" or when seq >= 256. But this doesn't fix repack overhead if KV layout changed.

Alex: Right — selector tweak avoids extra dequant work but repacking cost remains for cached KV blobs produced under the new layout. We'll still pay CPU/GPU copy overhead.

Priya: Plan: 1) revert #3421 to unblock customers (short term). 2) follow-up to reintroduce layout changes with a compatibility shim + verification vectors (long term).

Jenna: Filed issue #1314 for compatibility shim, selector tests, and long-seq perf CI coverage. Assigning to Marco/Alex.

Marco: Bisect log:
```
start: 1761900000 (good)
bad: 1761956120 (bad)
first-bad: 2e9c5a (PR #3421)
```

Priya: Annotated regression on release board: https://boards.internal/releases/2.3.1

Sam: Revert PR #3425 merged, starting rollback. Monitoring perf-ci.

perf-ci: [automated] rollback run for smoke/perf/gen_long_sequence_int8: gen_p95=179ms (within noise) :white_check_mark:.

Alex: Revert validated. Immediate blocker cleared.

Jenna: Follow-ups: add unit tests that exercise selector with seq=64/256/1024, add perf-ci job for int8 long-seq, and implement compatibility shim for KV packing.

Priya: Thanks. Assigning postmortem to Marco. Please upload traces and flamegraphs to the issue. :eyes:

Marco: Uploaded nvprof traces + flamegraphs to the issue: https://files.internal/trace/1761957

Priya: Good. Closing thread once the postmortem lands. :thumbsup:
